section: National Action Plan on Climate Change - the eight national missions; State Action Plans on Climate Change
subsections: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP
Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA

accepted.s: The exclusive Climate Change Cell established by Andhra Pradesh in November 2022 is presently known as the:
o: Andhra Pradesh State Climate Change Cell (APSCCC)
accepted.x: The exclusive cell created by Andhra Pradesh in November 2022 is now called the Andhra Pradesh State Climate Change Cell (APSCCC).
accepted.tq: Identify the exact official name and distinguish it from nearby institutional terms.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh State Climate Change Cell functions under the Department of:
accepted.x: APSCCC functions under the Department of Environment, Forests and Science & Technology.
accepted.tq: Use the department-versus-agency distinction to eliminate swapped administrative authorities.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the revised Andhra Pradesh State Action Plan on Climate Change:
1. It covers the period 2025–30.
2. It prescribes eight adaptation measures for the energy sector.
3. The measures are based on an assessment of vulnerability to rising temperatures, variable rainfall and extreme events.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The revised AP SAPCC covers 2025–30, includes eight energy-sector adaptation measures and is based on vulnerability to rising temperatures, variable rainfall and extreme events.
accepted.tq: Test several linked particulars together, including the period, number and basis of a policy.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following sets correctly identifies the implementing agencies for the eight energy-sector adaptation measures under the revised AP SAPCC?
o: AP-Genco, NREDCAP and AP Green Energy Corporation
APTRANSCO, APSRTC and AP Pollution Control Board
NREDCAP, AP Forest Department and AP Disaster Management Authority
AP-Genco, AP State Finance Department and APNGC
accepted.x: The implementing agencies are AP-Genco, NREDCAP and AP Green Energy Corporation.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure institutional pair and reject agencies belonging to other sectors.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Fridays For Future Andhra Pradesh participated in its first global climate strike in:
accepted.x: FFF-AP joined its first global climate strike in 2019.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely spaced years in a movement-related fact.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the green-cover targets of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has set an interim green-cover target of 37% by 2030 and a target of 50% by 2047.
accepted.tq: Compare paired percentages with their corresponding target years.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the stated green-cover requirement in Andhra Pradesh, industries are required to put what proportion of their premises under trees?
accepted.x: Industries are required to place 33% of their premises under trees.
accepted.tq: Test an exact percentage separately from the broader state-level targets.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh National Green Corps was set up in:
accepted.x: The AP National Green Corps was established in 2002–03; the national programme began in 2001–02.
accepted.tq: Separate the State implementation year from the national programme year.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the reported reach of the Andhra Pradesh National Green Corps?
o: 4,350 Eco-Clubs, 1.63 lakh students and 1.31 crore saplings
4,350 Eco-Clubs, 1.31 lakh students and 1.63 crore saplings
3,450 Eco-Clubs, 1.36 lakh students and 1.13 crore saplings
5,430 Eco-Clubs, 1.63 lakh students and 1.31 crore saplings
accepted.x: The reported figures are 4,350 Eco-Clubs, 1.63 lakh students and 1.31 crore saplings.
accepted.tq: Match all three quantitative components rather than relying on one familiar figure.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following are identified as vulnerable sectors and climate-related stresses in Andhra Pradesh?
1. Heatwaves, droughts, floods and cyclones
2. Water, agriculture, food security and health
3. Only coastal tourism and urban transport
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Heatwaves, droughts, floods and cyclones affect water, agriculture, food security and health. The vulnerability list is not restricted to coastal tourism and urban transport.
accepted.tq: Find the incorrect over-restrictive statement containing the word “only”.
accepted.sec: AP climate action - Climate Change Cell, AP SAPCC, FFF-AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a sub-mission of the Green India Mission?
o: Expansion of forest and tree cover and ecosystem restoration
Improvement of incomes of forest-dependent people
accepted.x: The three sub-missions concern forest quality, forest and tree cover with ecosystem restoration, and incomes of forest-dependent people. Thermal power generation is not a GIM sub-mission.
accepted.tq: Find the outsider among closely related environmental programme components.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: The Green India Mission target combines:
o: 3 million hectares of new cover and improvement in the quality of 5 million hectares
10 million hectares of new cover without any quality-improvement target
5 million hectares of new cover and improvement in the quality of 5 million hectares
5 million hectares of new cover and improvement in the quality of 3 million hectares
accepted.x: GIM targets 5 million hectares of new cover and quality improvement over another 5 million hectares.
accepted.tq: Split a combined target into its two equal quantitative components.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the livelihood and carbon-sequestration targets associated with the Green India Mission?
o: About 5 million households and 30–40 Mt of annual sequestration by 2030
About 3 million households and 2.5–3.0 billion tonnes of annual sequestration by 2020
About 10 million households and 50–60 Mt of annual sequestration by 2030
About 3 million households and 50–60 Mt of additional annual sequestration by 2020
accepted.x: The mission sought livelihood income for about 3 million households and 50–60 Mt of extra annual sequestration by 2020. Its additional sink target by 2030 is separately expressed as 2.5–3.0 billion tonnes of CO2 equivalent.
accepted.tq: Keep apart the household, annual sequestration and 2030 sink figures.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: According to the cited CAG audit of the Green India Mission, which pair correctly represents the area of quality improvement and cover increase achieved during 2015–16 to 2024–25?
accepted.x: The audit reported quality improvement on 0.11384 Mha and cover increase on 0.03409 Mha. These were far below the corresponding 1.4 Mha benchmarks.
accepted.tq: Preserve the order of two similar-looking decimal figures and their associated activities.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: The National Water Mission seeks to increase water-use efficiency by:
o: 20% through basin-level integrated water resources management
accepted.x: One of the National Water Mission goals is a 20% increase in water-use efficiency through basin-level integrated water resources management.
accepted.tq: Link the quantitative target with the correct planning scale and management approach.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT among the stated goals of the National Water Mission?
o: Replacement of basin-level planning by exclusive national-level planning
Creation of a public water database
accepted.x: The National Water Mission includes a public water database, impact assessment, citizen and State action, focus on over-exploited areas and improved water-use efficiency through basin-level IWRM. It does not replace basin-level planning with exclusive national-level planning.
accepted.tq: Reject the statement that reverses the stated decentralised and basin-level approach.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: The National Water Mission provides funds for:
accepted.x: The National Water Mission funds State Specific Action Plans; the stated provision for major States is ₹50 lakh.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact plan category funded by the mission instead of a neighbouring sectoral plan.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: Under the Perform, Achieve and Trade mechanism, energy-intensive units that exceed their energy-saving targets receive:
o: Energy Saving Certificates that can be traded
Carbon tax rebates issued by State governments
accepted.x: PAT rewards industries that beat their energy-saving targets with tradable Energy Saving Certificates.
accepted.tq: Identify the market instrument generated by achievement of a performance target.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture:
1. It was launched in 2014–15 under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
2. It became part of Green Revolution–Krishonnati in 2018–19.
3. It has been under PM-RKVY since 2022–23.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: NMSA was launched in 2014–15, integrated with Green Revolution–Krishonnati in 2018–19 and placed under PM-RKVY from 2022–23.
accepted.tq: Arrange successive administrative affiliations as a sequence of dated statements.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a component of the National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture?
accepted.x: NMSA includes Rainfed Area Development, On-Farm Water Management and Soil Health Management, along with a Sub-Mission on Agroforestry. Urban Waste-to-Energy Management is not one of its components.
accepted.tq: Find the unrelated component among similarly named environmental and agricultural measures.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding assistance under the National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture is correct?
o: Micro-irrigation receives a fixed 33% subsidy and Soil Health Cards are issued once in five years.
Micro-irrigation receives up to 55% subsidy and Soil Health Cards are issued every two years free of cost.
Micro-irrigation receives up to 75% subsidy and Soil Health Cards are issued annually for a fee.
Micro-irrigation is not subsidised and Soil Health Cards are issued only on request.
accepted.x: NMSA provides up to 55% subsidy for micro-irrigation, and Soil Health Cards are issued free every two years.
accepted.tq: Match the percentage and periodicity without swapping either quantitative detail.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: Under the Integrated Farming Systems support associated with NMSA, the assistance specified per family is:
accepted.x: The specified assistance for Integrated Farming Systems is ₹30,000 per family.
accepted.tq: Test the exact amount separately from the percentage-based subsidy figure.
accepted.sec: Mission objectives - GIM, NWM, PAT, NMSA  [other exams]

accepted.s: The evolution of State Action Plans on Climate Change is best represented by which of the following?
o: From district-specific adaptation plans to broad mitigation plans
From broad mitigation plans during 2010–15 to district-specific, risk-based adaptation plans from 2020 onwards
From national mitigation plans to plans unrelated to local institutions
From risk-based plans during 2010–15 to purely sector-neutral plans after 2020
accepted.x: States have moved from broad mitigation-centric plans in 2010–15 towards district-specific, risk-based adaptation plans from 2020 onwards, linked with social schemes and local institutions.
accepted.tq: Use the time markers to identify the direction of policy evolution.
accepted.sec: SAPCC - states, vulnerability, state cells  [other exams]

accepted.s: The National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem and Knowledge supports:
o: State Climate Change Centres and vulnerability assessments at State and district levels
replacement of all State climate plans by a single Union plan
accepted.x: NMSKCC supports State Climate Change Centres and vulnerability assessments at both State and district levels.
accepted.tq: Match the mission with its institutional and assessment function.
accepted.sec: SAPCC - states, vulnerability, state cells  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the relationship among NDCs, the National Adaptation Plan and State Action Plans on Climate Change?
o: SAPCCs replace the National Adaptation Plan and national missions.
NDCs are delivered only through international treaties and not through domestic plans.
NDCs are delivered through the National Adaptation Plan, national missions and SAPCCs.
The National Adaptation Plan applies only to urban local bodies.
accepted.x: NDC implementation is pursued through the National Adaptation Plan, national missions and State Action Plans on Climate Change.
accepted.tq: Test the relationship among national commitments and domestic implementation channels.
accepted.sec: SAPCC - states, vulnerability, state cells  [other exams]

accepted.s: A proposal for climate budgeting through State Finance Departments envisages implementation through:
accepted.x: The proposal is to introduce climate budgeting through State Finance Departments by means of a budget circular.
accepted.tq: Identify the administrative instrument associated with a budgeting proposal.
accepted.sec: SAPCC - states, vulnerability, state cells  [other exams]

accepted.s: A WRI study cited in relation to climate adaptation investment estimates that such investment can yield approximately:
accepted.x: The cited WRI study estimates a ten-fold return on adaptation investment.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among nearby multiplier values in an economic-environmental claim.
accepted.sec: SAPCC - states, vulnerability, state cells  [other exams]
